material_findings.title: QHack 2026 is open for registration with $67,000 in coding-challenge cash awards
material_findings.summary: Xanadu's current QHack 2026 terms define an online quantum coding competition running Oct. 16 at 10:00 AM ET through Oct. 23 at 6:00 PM ET. Teams may contain one to four participants and may submit answers to up to twenty coding challenges across three difficulty levels. The top ten cash awards are $15,000, $13,000, $11,000, $7,000, $6,000, $5,000, $4,000, $3,000, $2,000 and $1,000, totaling $67,000. No purchase is necessary. Eligibility excludes residents of Quebec, Russia, Iran, North Korea and Belarus and otherwise requires age of majority under Ontario law or written parent/guardian consent. Entries must be original, in English, and acknowledge past work used.
